messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: HIGH - tenant-quality-drop for tenant zephyr-analytics on dedicated dp-9-vpc. Metric: mean_generation_score -25% vs baseline. Trigger: tenant-quant-eval-fail. Page: @taylor (oncall).

(taylor (oncall) joined): ack, investigating. pulling recent profile changes + last deploys.

omar (sre): I'm in. any recent quant profile applies for zephyr?

(taylor (oncall)): yes, I see a tenant profile apply ~4120003000: qprofile-2026-04-02-zephyr. Applied across dp-9-vpc.

priya (eng-ml): joining. That profile name matches the new quant calibration run we pushed yesterday. Could be the culprit. Quick plan: 1) revert tenant profile to qprofile-stable-2026-03-20 2) if revert doesn't recover quality, switch traffic to unquantized variant or fallback pool 3) kick off RCA. Need SRE to approve traffic actions.

omar (sre): approve revert. We'll do the minimum blast radius first.

(taylor (oncall)): executing revert commands now. running:

```
# revert tenant quant profile
redwood tenant profile set --tenant zephyr-analytics --profile qprofile-stable-2026-03-20
# graceful recycle of tenant workers
redwood infra restart-workers --pool dp-9-vpc --tenant zephyr-analytics --grace-period 30s
```

deploy-bot: rollback job RB-412-01 queued by taylor (oncall) for tenant zephyr-analytics.

deploy-bot: RB-412-01 started on 5 hosts. streaming status...

pagerduty-bot: scheduling handoff in 40m to mara (next oncall).

omar (sre): while job runs, I'll cordon pool scheduling for tenant-scoped ops and add temporary policy to prevent accidental re-applies.

(4m later)

deploy-bot: RB-412-01 completed: 5/5 hosts updated, health checks ok.

(taylor (oncall)): running quick smoke suite for zephyr golden prompts (internal). Will post evals.

(2m)

priya (eng-ml): preliminary evals look promising: mean_generation_score back to -1% vs baseline. Manual spot-checks look good.

lucy (acct-eng): pinging zephyr-analytics support and their engineering contact: "We detected a tenant-scoped model quality regression and rolled back the tenant quant profile. Please verify on your end and let us know if you see anything. We'll follow up with RCA." (sent).

omar (sre): monitoring metrics for 30 minutes. No CPU/GPU anomalies. throughput and latency unchanged.

(taylor (oncall)): incident status: mitigated. Creating incident INC-2026-0599 and assigning to eng-ml (priya) for RCA and remediation tasks.

priya (eng-ml): I'll own the RCA. Immediate next steps: 1) reproduce regression locally using qprofile-2026-04-02-zephyr pipeline 2) diff quantization parameters vs stable 3) run end-to-end eval on tenant prompt set 4) propose fixes (calibration, clamp params, or require canary). Also propose adding pre-apply evaluation job against tenant-specific golden prompts.

omar (sre): infra follow-up: add guardrail to block tenant-scoped profile applies on dedicated/VPC pools unless an automated canary pass exists. Also add an audit hook to log profile diffs.

(taylor (oncall)): handoff notes: I'll monitor for 1 hour then mark resolved if stable. Expect eng-ml RCA in 3 business days.

(1h later)

taylor (oncall): 1-hour monitoring complete. Stable. Marking incident resolved and attaching smoke artifacts to INC-2026-0599.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED - INC-2026-0599. Summary: tenant-specific quant profile qprofile-2026-04-02-zephyr introduced a regression for zephyr-analytics on dp-9-vpc; rollback to qprofile-stable-2026-03-20 mitigated impact. Action items: eng-ml RCA (priya), infra policy for canary gating, platform to add tenant pre-apply eval.

priya (eng-ml): I'll add repro logs, quant diffs, and suggested mitigations to the ticket. ETA 72h.

lucy (acct-eng): Zephyr confirmed their staging tests look normal now and requested an executive note. I'll send an update after RCA.

omar (sre): leaving a permanent note: avoid direct tenant profile flips in dedicated pools without a canary and a metric gate.

(taylor (oncall)): thanks team. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
